bugs.theme: Shell injection via execSync string interpolation (git/ingester)
bugs.rootCause: Command strings built by concatenation and executed through a shell; count/hash inputs accepted raw values.
bugs.fix: execFileSync('git', args[]) with no shell; sanitizeCount (finite, 1-1000) and sanitizeHash (^[0-9a-f]{4,40}$) guards.

bugs.theme: Denylist bypass — regex-shaped patterns matched as literals
bugs.rootCause: Regex-shaped denylist entries matched with command.includes(pattern) made them dead code; case/whitespace-sensitive matching.
bugs.fix: Denylist entries compiled as RegExp (flag i); whitespace normalized before checks.

bugs.theme: Allowlist bypass — prefix match + shell:true metacharacter injection
bugs.rootCause: command.startsWith(a) prefix match with spawn shell:true permitted chained commands (git status; rm -rf /).
bugs.fix: Token-based first-token exact match + unquoted-shell-metacharacter rejection.

bugs.theme: Shell injection — git-driver execSync string interpolation
bugs.rootCause: execSync('git ' + args); commit/push/pull/checkout interpolated raw message/branch/hash/author.
bugs.fix: execFileSync('git', args[]) arg arrays for every call; hash/branch/remote/author validated before use.

bugs.theme: Bash tool — full shell exec with no denylist, no containment
bugs.rootCause: exec(command, { shell }) with no denylist; destructive classification advisory only.
bugs.fix: Shared DEFAULT_DENYLIST + bash-specific patterns (download-execute chains, Remove-Item -Recurse/-Force, del /s, rm -rf ~); unquoted injection metacharacters rejected; timeout capped at 600s; blocked commands surface as isError.

bugs.theme: File Read/Write/Edit tools — no path containment
bugs.rootCause: path.resolve(context.cwd, file_path) with no containment check; Write mkdir -p'd parents.
bugs.fix: resolveWithinRoot rejects path.relative results starting with '..' or absolute; applied to Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep.

bugs.rootCause: resolved.startsWith(rootResolved) prefix collision; Windows case-insensitivity and symlink/junction escapes unhandled.
bugs.fix: Lexical path.relative + separator-aware case-folded prefix check + realpath walk to nearest existing ancestor with case-folded re-check.

bugs.theme: FileEditor undo of created file writes empty file
bugs.rootCause: backup() stored content ?? ''; undo() null-check was dead code.
bugs.fix: FileBackup.existed boolean recorded; undo removes the file when it did not exist.
